en.headline: Ocean Park’s Halloween Fest continues with night-time haunted experiences through early November
en.dek: The Grave Rave season includes Under the Castle and other attractions on designated evenings until 1 November, according to the park.
body: Ocean Park’s Halloween Fest 2026, themed The Grave Rave, remains open with daytime activities daily until 1 November and night-time haunted experiences on selected dates.

The park said daytime experiences run from 5 September to 1 November. Night-time attractions, including several haunted experiences, operate from 5pm to 11pm on 9–11, 16–19, 23–25 and 30–31 October, plus 1 November. One featured experience is Under the Castle, an original fantasy concept created and creatively directed by Jackson Wang.

Other elements include additional walk-through attractions, roaming characters, live performances such as cosplay gatherings and stage shows, and themed activities across the Waterfront and Summit areas. The park has listed general admission and add-on ticket options for the special experiences on its official channels.
Visitors are advised to check the park’s daily schedule, as event dates and hours for specific attractions can vary.

zh.headline: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭持續 指定晚間驚嚇體驗至11月1日
zh.dek: 主題「詭魅墓會」日間活動每日開放至11月1日，夜間鬼屋等體驗於指定日子舉行。
body: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭2026以「詭魅墓會」為主題，日間體驗持續至11月1日，夜間驚嚇體驗則於指定日子開放。
公園表示，日間體驗由9月5日起至11月1日每日進行。夜間體驗包括多項驚嚇項目，於10月9至11日、16至19日、23至25日、30至31日及11月1日下午5時至11時開放。其中一項為由王嘉爾主理及擔任創意總監的原創奇幻概念Under the Castle驚嚇體驗。
活動亦包括其他步行驚嚇體驗、全園嘩鬼角色、舞台表演如Cosplay派對，以及海濱樂園及高峰樂園的主題活動。公園已在官方渠道列出一般入場及附加體驗門票選項。
公園提醒訪客留意每日時間表，個別項目的開放日子及時段或有不同。
